output.reason: [ev-d6005e84dee9] says, under the upgrade notes' "Changed Metrics" heading, only that the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`. A metric is something Cilium emits, not a value an operator configures, so setting-ignored does not fit. The evidence does not say that anything fails, so a mandatory-work kind would over-claim. The metric is still emitted under its new name, so the observable effect is a behavior-change: anything that queries the old name should be reviewed.

correction.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` is renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`. The metric is still emitted under the new name, so consumers of the old name should review their usage.

consequence.statement: Cilium exposes this metric as `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` instead of `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count`. Dashboards, alerts or queries that use the old name will not match the renamed metric.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, recording or alerting rules and queries to use `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` instead of `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count`.
